prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. A four-asset illustration sheet for Android FitnessApp, exercise Press sentado con mancuernas (shoulders_seated_dumbbell_press). EXACT FOUR EQUAL PANELS, STRICT 2x2 grid with perfectly centered vertical and horizontal division. No borders, no margins, NO TEXT NO LABELS NO NUMBERS NO LOGOS. Upper-left movement initial position; upper-right middle of movement; lower-left final contraction/end range; lower-right muscle map. The first three panels show same realistic adult athlete, same modest charcoal sleeveless gym top and shorts, same camera angle and same equipment; three clearly DIFFERENT poses to explain the motion. Choose three-quarter SIDE view that makes the movement and joint angles unmistakable. All relevant limbs and equipment fully inside each panel, normal five-finger hands, plausible equipment and joints. Dark studio background #121416, warm soft champagne rim light, consistent photorealistic 3D educational illustration, realistic light loads. Setup: Respaldo casi vertical. Siéntate con la espalda apoyada y las mancuernas a la altura de las orejas, palmas al frente. Sequence technique: Empuja las mancuernas hacia arriba hasta casi estirar los brazos. Acércalas ligeramente arriba sin chocarlas. Baja con control hasta que queden a la altura de las orejas. Show EXACT named variant and equipment, not a substitute movement. Do not merge multiple athletes in a movement panel. No arrows inside frames. Bottom-right panel contains two faceless medical teaching mannequins front and back in opaque gray sports suits with colored muscle overlays, with accurately bounded colored muscles, no glow, no heatmap. Primary deltoid muscles pale champagne. For overhead press focus anterior and middle deltoid, triceps secondary amber. For lateral raises focus lateral deltoid only, upper trapezius secondary. For rear fly focus POSTERIOR deltoid on back view, rhomboids secondary, not anterior shoulders. Primary color #D8C3A5; secondary #A77B47; unworked skin/muscles gray. Other figures and diagrams must not intrude in movement panels. Four assets will be cropped into independent rectangular images. Keep composition centered with 5% breathing room within EACH quadrant. Avoid decorative text, incorrect cable attachment, floating handles, disconnected weights. Instructional visual draft, not diagnosis.
